pages.text: Mine Arcane Crystals and put dark magic to work — Forbidden & Arcanus is T3's dark-magic mod, built around the Arcane Crystal crafting system.

$(bold)Role in the pack:$() Arcane Crystals are a unique T3 crafting material used in several cross-mod recipes. The mod's Runic Ritual system supplements Occultism for advanced T3 magic crafting.$(br2)$(bold)Mundabitur Dust:$() Key material for T3 Archmage and Battlemage gear enhancement paths.
$(bold)Stellarite:$() T4 material from Forbidden & Arcanus. Requires deep T3 investment to produce. Used in several T4 endgame recipes.

$(bold)Where the reference lives:$() Forbidden & Arcanus mechanics are covered by JEI tooltips and recipes — every ritual input and crystal product is listed there.$(br2)$(bold)Next: set up an Arcane Crystal Obelisk and start generating Aureal.$()
